messages:
ana: quick follow-up from the spike of pages last night. goal: assign owners + minimal timelines for alert tuning so we don't get a repeat. items: 
- noisy cpu alert -> raise threshold + 24h dry-run (owner: vik) 72h
- error-rate dedupe -> job-level dedupe key (owner: harry) 7d
- paging policy tweak: low->slack, med->oncall daytime only; 14d grandfathering (owner: ana) 48h
please ack and call out blockers. tagging @ops-bot to create tracker. :wave:

vik: ack. i'm on cpu. plan: bump from 0.85->0.92 in staging, 24h dry-run then prod if steady. will paste rule diff.

harry: taking dedupe. agree job-level dedupe so autoscaled instances don't spam. will add `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}'` and open PR by Thu.

ana: (typo) ana: @harry that's perfect. daytime window 09:00-18:00 PT. we'll exclude k8s-control-plane from suppression lists.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-5510 "Alert tuning follow-up: cpu thresh, dedupe, paging" assigned to [vik, harry, ana] due 2026-06-01 :white_check_mark:

oncall-rotations: note: i'll update rota rules when the paging policy PR merges so daytime routing is enforced.

vik: rule diff for staging:
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.85
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.92
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will watch dashboards and rollback if we see missed capacity alerts.

harry: PR opened for dedupe template and added a CI smoke job that fires synthetic errors to validate dedupe behavior.

ana: thanks all. i'll consolidate into the postmortem action tracker and close the task when owners mark done. final checklist: vik (72h), harry (7d), ana (48h). flag here if you need more time. :thumbsup:
